description: This file contains functions and types related to determining whether branding should be hidden for users, teams, and events within a profile feature, including external repository and logger integrations.

methods.name: resolveHideBranding
methods.description: Determines if branding should be hidden based on organization and entity settings.

methods.name: getHideBranding
methods.description: Fetches and resolves hide branding status for a user or team by their IDs.

methods.name: shouldHideBrandingForEventUsingProfile
methods.description: Determines hide branding for an event using owner profile or team data.

methods.name: shouldHideBrandingForEvent
methods.description: Fetches profile if needed and determines hide branding for an event.

methods.name: shouldHideBrandingForTeamEvent
methods.description: Wrapper for team event hide branding check.

methods.name: shouldHideBrandingForUserEvent
methods.description: Wrapper for user event hide branding check.
